title: Three-query linear sign tester
statement: For a natural number $n$, an $n$-dimensional three-query linear sign tester consists of a finite seed set with a probability distribution, a sign specifying the right-hand side for each seed, and three queries in $\\{−1,1\}^n$ selected for each seed.
hypotheses_covered: Probability mass function on the seed type
